POSH Inquiry Navigator

Digital delivery and access

Live online purchases are currently closed.

Navigator plans are delivered online. There is no physical shipment. After Navigator verifies a captured payment, the purchaser can sign in with the confirmed order email and open My workspace to find their plan, seat limit and access dates. The buyer can assign remaining seats to confirmed Navigator accounts during the editing term.

Checklist access and delivery

After verified payment capture, the original buyer can use the IC / LC Inquiry Checklist online for 120 days. Ticks stay in the browser used to mark them. The separate Compliance Checklist opens an online assessment. Sign in to resume it and download the final report after finalising.

View the Essential sample invoice (PDF) for an illustration of the Essential plan invoice.

Payment or access problem

If checkout closes or activation is missing after a debit, check My workspace first. Contact training@thecosmicenergizers.com with the order reference, amount and approximate payment time before trying to pay again. Keep sign-in codes and inquiry records private.

At the end of the term

During the three-calendar-month read-only period, authorised users can review a saved recovery file locally. Save your own recovery files and exports before editing ends and keep them in your institution’s authorised custody.
